hero.name: Sanghyeon Shin
hero.title: IT planner who defines problems with data, then builds and ships
hero.subtitle: I don't stop at planning docs. I frame problems in numbers, design screens in Figma, and build them with React and Next.js. Currently PM of CleanB, an Airbnb cleaning matching service running in production.

about.heading: About
about.description_1: Community Manager Intern at LIKELION, running a community of ~2,500 members across 80 universities. At the same time, PM of CleanB (3-person team) — owning planning, design, and releases while building the cleaner-side frontend myself.
about.description_2: Double major in Global Business & Technology and AI Convergence. Through LIKELION staff roles, hackathons, and startup programs I've planned and built 15 services, 11 of which won awards. Currently filling gaps in backend and QA through SSAFY's Java track.
about.description_3: Products people actually use, decisions backed by data, and teams that grow together — my goal is to be a PM who delivers all three at once.
